I’m heading to
UiPath
FUSION to talk about winning with AI, which sounds straightforward until you start asking what “winning” actually means. It’s not having the most pilots, the flashiest demo or the longest list of AI use cases. 

It’s knowing where the technology can make a meaningful difference, being honest about whether your organization is ready to support it, and making the changes that turn a promising experiment into something people actually use. 

That’s what I’ll be covering in my keynote, “Winning with AI: Embrace Change and Leapfrog the Competition.” 

If you’re going to be at
#UiPathFUSION
in Las Vegas tomorrow, come join me:
https://lnkd.in/eMR9eDKh
P.S. If you'd like to come and chat afterwards, I'm known to hang out for a few minutes after my keynotes by the doors to the venue, so please come say hi! I'd love to meet you.

Bags packed. Hoodies packed. Vegas, here I come. Tomorrow
UiPath
FUSION 2026 kicks off at Wynn Las Vegas, and I will be there in person covering all 4 days for
The Ravit Show
.
 
Here is why I am excited.
 
Almost every leader I talk to is stuck in the same spot. Lots of AI pilots. Very few in production. FUSION is built around that exact gap. Even the theme says it straight: Where AI Meets ROI.
 
What is on my list:
 
-
Daniel Dines
on stage with customers sharing what actually worked
-
Raghu Malpani
showing coding agents, the AI-native canvas and agentic testing
-
Cassie Kozyrkov
and Dr. Kate Darling, 2 people I could listen to for hours
- The Experts Arena with 35 experts, 14 partners and 64 in-depth sessions
 
And yes, SOFI TUKKER is there too. Enterprise AI by day, dance floor by night. Only in Vegas.
 
Swipe through the carousel for all 8 reasons to attend. My favourite is #1. Move beyond pilots. That is the conversation every CIO wants to have right now.
 
I will be interviewing leaders, catching hallway conversations and sharing the best bits here all week.
 
If you are at FUSION, come say hi. Look for the guy in the teal hoodie and yes other colours too. Hard to miss.
 
Not making it to Vegas? Follow along. I will bring FUSION to you.

Years ago, it became clear to us that our customers' hardest problem would be coordinating work from beginning to end, and we started building for it. We bet on orchestration because that is where the challenge sits. A process has to exist in a form that agents and people can both act on, held and governed in one place, and coordinated with the systems doing the rest of the work. That layer is orchestration, and it is what we chose to build the
UiPath
Platform around.

Today, UiPath has been named a Leader in the
Gartner
Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. This one means a great deal to me. Execution is whether what we build holds up in production. Vision is whether we are building the right thing for what comes next. Being recognized in both says the direction was right, and that the market now sees it the same way.

Thank you to the UiPath team for the years of work behind this, and to our customers for trusting us.

You can read the full report here:
https://lnkd.in/ggzzZkzz
